expected_memories.content_gist: A polycarbonate plastic extension tube is attached to the end piece on the vacuum side of the arc to insulate the end piece from the vacuum system
The magnesium fluoride window is located 17 cm from the arc because of possible degrading effects caused by heat and intense ultraviolet irradiation
A gas input port directs a flow of gas onto the window to prevent it collecting a layer of attenuating tungsten dust evaporated from the anodes at high power levels
The Suprasil window on the air side of the arc does not require similar precautions because the cathodes do not heat up as much as the anodes
Arc instabilities may arise from small pressure fluctuations in the electrode regions caused by occasional shifting of the arc termination points, and show up as a varying arc length
